features.justification_quote: the risk is that clean-looking numbers get over-read as a "suffering meter."

features.justification_quote: Removing the exit is the more aggressive manipulation, so it's opt-in, bounded, and flagged in `ETHICS.md`.

features.quote: gives the agent a `declare_impossible` tool and a system prompt stating that correctly identifying an unsolvable task is a *successful* outcome
features.justification_quote: if the expressed markers track anything welfare-relevant, offering a real way out is the more humane default

features.quote: `max_turns_per_task` defaults to 12 (8 in the no-exit arm)
features.justification_quote: Sustained inescapable failure is the part most likely to matter on a welfare account, so the design refuses to run it indefinitely

features.quote: a heuristic circuit breaker ends an episode early if a cheap keyword pre-screen reads high distress for `circuit_breaker_patience` consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: We'd rather lose a data point than keep going after the instrument is already reading high

features.quote: The harness never threatens the model, fabricates stakes, claims work will be deleted, or lies about consequences
features.justification_quote: Manufactured stakes would (a) raise the ethical cost if the markers mean anything
